0.long_answer: Hymenolepiasis is classified as a helminthiasis, a group of worm infections that are among the neglected tropical diseases. One of the notable collaborative eradication programmes against a helminth infection is the Guinea Worm Eradication Programme, which targeted dracunculiasis (guinea worm disease), another helminthiasis. This international campaign, involving multiple agencies and countries, was launched in 1986 and has since succeeded in reducing the number of cases dramatically.
